name: College Preview (pre-college art and design program)
what_you_do: You spend two weeks on campus. You take college-level classes in an art or design major. You earn college credit. You build a portfolio. You show work in a gallery exhibition.
who_can_apply: Rising high school sophomores, juniors and seniors (grades 10 to 12) interested in art and design.
pay_detail: Commuter $3,000 total. Residential $3,600 total (adds $600 room and board). A $250 deposit is due when you register. Scholarships available.
duration: 2 weeks in summer 2027. The page text does not list the session dates.
deadline_text: Registration is open for summer 2027 and closes May 10, 2027. Registering by Feb 15, 2027 waives the $250 deposit. Scholarship applications run Nov 3, 2026 to April 27, 2027.
how_to_apply: Register online and pay the $250 deposit. Scholarship applicants submit a form, a 300 to 500 word personal statement, three artwork samples and a NACAC fee waiver.
notes: Fees shown are the 2027 prices. Meals are included on weekdays. Refunds: tuition balance less the registration fee is refunded in full if withdrawn by June 14, 2027 and half by June 28, 2027.
